svg.font-family: Calibri, Carlito, 'Noto Sans', 'Segoe UI', Arial, sans-serif
svg.title: ThinkSlides system architecture
svg.desc: The browser talks to the Go orchestrator over HTTPS and a resumable SSE stream. The orchestrator admits a run and appends it to a Redis stream; AI run workers consume it, call language models per role, hand rendering to a process pool, and publish events back through Redis. PostgreSQL with pgvector holds every record, the run state and the evidence store.
svg.text: JWT in header, or ?token= for SSE
fanned out to every open tab;
one run per task: the pipeline of Figure 3;
